x: DeltaLoader lets you run native mods inside Stormworks: Build and Rescue. It consists of four parts that work together: Part What it is DeltaLauncher A Windows app. It lists mods from the DeltaV mods site, installs them, switches them on or off and starts the game. Injector (swinject.exe) Loads a mod DLL into the running game after checking that the game matches. The launcher installs and updates it for you. Version patch (swversion.dll) Built into the launcher. Shows the DeltaLoader label in the game; it is loaded before the mods. SDK Public C++ headers and sources for writing your own mods. Everything the loader knows about the game comes from a mapping: names, addresses, signatures and layouts observed from a legally purchased copy. The documentation says clearly what is proven and what is not. What you can do Install and update mods from a catalog with one click. Switch mods on and off, then start the game with exactly the mods you chose. Add your own meshes, textures, shaders and data to the game without editing the game folder (mod folders). Write mods in C++ that hook game functions, watch live objects, place tiles, change weather and more. What it does not do Single-player only DeltaLoader is for your own copy in single-player. It does not work in multiplayer, it does not bypass anti-cheat and it refuses to attach when an anti-cheat module is present. Do not load mods into other people's servers. It does not modify game files permanently. Overlays are restored when the game ends. It does not guess. If the game executable does not match the mapping, mods do not start at all. Where to go next Playing: start with [Installation](/getting-started/installation/), then [Installing mods](/players/installing-mods/). Making mods: read [Development environment setup](/developer/environment/) and [Creating your first mod](/developer/first-mod/). How it works inside: [Loader architecture](/technical/architecture/).

To play with mods Requirement Details Operating system Windows 10 or Windows 11, 64-bit Game Stormworks: Build and Rescue (Steam), 64-bit executable stormworks64.exe Game version The version listed under [Supported game versions](/resources/game-versions/). The loader fails closed on any other build. WebView2 The launcher window needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime. It is present on current Windows 10 and 11. Rights Start launcher and game with the same rights (both normal, or both as administrator). Only 64-bit The game and the dedicated server have been 64-bit only since v1.15.25. There is no 32-bit support. To build mods Requirement Details Windows 64-bit CMake 3.20 or newer Compiler Visual Studio 2022 with the Desktop development with C++ workload (MSVC) Language C++17 See [Development environment setup](/developer/environment/).

Steps Open [the DeltaV mods site](https://stormworks-tools.com/) and use the Download DeltaLauncher button on the start page. No account is needed. [TODO: Confirm whether the download is the installer, the portable deltalauncher.exe, or both.] Run it. The installer needs no options; the portable file can be started from any folder. If Windows SmartScreen warns that the file is not signed, choose More info, then Run anyway. Start the launcher. On the first start it looks for your Stormworks folder (see [First launch](/getting-started/first-launch/)). Antivirus The launcher starts programs (the injector) and writes a DLL next to it. Some virus scanners remove the injector. If the Injector page says the file was removed, allow it in Windows Security and press Check again. What gets installed where The launcher keeps its own data in %APPDATA%\DeltaVModdingLauncher\: File or folder Purpose settings.json API address, game folder and switches installed.json Which mods are installed mods\<project id>\ Downloaded mod DLLs bin\swinject.exe, bin\swversion.dll Injector and version patch Mods you switch on are copied into <game folder>\mods\. Game files are not modified.

1. Game folder Open Settings → Game. The launcher finds the folder through the Steam libraries. If it does not, press Detect or enter the folder that contains stormworks64.exe. 2. Injector Open the Injector page. A fresh launcher already carries the injector, so no download is needed. The page shows the installed version and whether it is up to date. 3. Your first mod Open Browse and install a mod. Open Installed and switch it on. Press Play. If Stormworks is not running, Play starts it through Steam and loads the version patch and every switched-on mod once the game process exists. If the game is already running, the switches are applied in place. You know it worked when the game shows the DeltaLoader version label and the Log page lists your mod. Load delay Settings has a load delay (default 5 seconds) that gives the game time to start before mods are loaded.

h.t: The injector and the version patch

x: The launcher The launcher checks the mods site for a newer launcher and installs it silently (/S /UPDATE /R): no setup wizard, and the launcher starts again by itself. You can check by hand under Settings → Launcher → Check for updates. The injector and the version patch The injector and the version patch are built into the launcher. An older injector in your bin folder is replaced at launcher start and before the game starts; a newer one from the API is kept. After a game update A game update changes the executable. Mods then stay out of the game on purpose until the loader is updated for the new build: Wait for a launcher/injector release for the new game version (see the [Changelog](/resources/changelog/) and [Supported game versions](/resources/game-versions/)). Let the launcher update itself. Update your mods if they show an update in Installed.

In Installed, remove all mods (this deletes their DLLs from the game's mods folder and from the launcher store). Close Stormworks and the launcher. Uninstall the launcher through Windows Settings → Apps (installer version) or delete the portable file. Optional: delete %APPDATA%\DeltaVModdingLauncher\ and, in the game folder, mods\activemods.ini. The game folder itself is not modified by the loader. Overlays that the launcher laid over rom while the game ran are restored when the game ends; if the game crashed, the launcher restores them at its next start.

h.t: Is this safe for my save?
Will it break when the game updates?
Does it modify my game files?
Can I use Workshop addons and DeltaLoader mods together?
Where do I ask for help?

x: Is this safe for my save? A mod runs inside the game process, so a bug in a mod can crash the game. Back up your save before trying new mods. Does it work in multiplayer? No. DeltaLoader is for single-player. It aborts when it sees an anti-cheat module. Will it break when the game updates? Mods will stop loading until the loader is updated. That is intended: wrong addresses would corrupt the game instead. Does it modify my game files? Not permanently. Mods are kept in a separate mods folder, and the DLLs are injected into the running game. Mod asset files (meshes, shaders, islands) are shown to the game through an overlay or a virtual file system; with the overlay the files are laid over rom while the game runs and the originals are restored when it ends. Can I use Workshop addons and DeltaLoader mods together? Yes. Lua addons are the game's own supported route and run inside the game; DeltaLoader mods are native DLLs. They do not interfere. Are there mod profiles? Not in the current launcher. See [Mod profiles](/players/profiles/). Do I need an account? Not to browse or download mods. An account is needed to publish and manage projects. Where do I ask for help? On the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/HH3ezeD8BD). See also [Community links](/resources/community/) and the [GitHub repository](/resources/github/).

h.t: If the game folder is unknown

x: From the launcher Open Browse. Search, or filter by category. Press Install on a version. The launcher downloads the DLL, checks its SHA-256 against the value published by the API and only then writes it to disk. A mismatch installs nothing. Open Installed and switch the mod on, then press Play. From the website The mods site has an Install button. It opens a short dialog and asks Windows to open a deltav://install?... link. The launcher registers that link type for your user at every start. A running launcher installs the latest version and shows it under Installed. Note If the launcher has never run on this PC, the dialog links to the launcher download instead. Island packages The Islands chip in Browse lists island packages. Installing one unpacks it, copies its files into rom (never over a game file) and switches the map on. Removing it deletes exactly the files it copied. If the game folder is unknown The download stays in the launcher store (%APPDATA%\DeltaVModdingLauncher\mods) and is copied into the game folder as soon as you switch the mod on.

Switch off: in Installed, turn the switch off. The mod stays installed but is not loaded the next time you press Play. Remove: Remove deletes the DLL from the game's mods folder and from the launcher store. A loaded mod is locked If a mod is loaded in the running game you get "... is loaded in the game and locked". Close the game, or unload the mod first, then remove it again. Mods loaded by the in-game menu A mod that the in-game mod menu loaded itself cannot be unloaded by the launcher. Switch it off in the in-game menu.

Open Installed and press Check for updates. The launcher asks the mods site for newer versions. An Update button appears next to every mod with a newer version. Press it. The same SHA-256 check as for a fresh install applies. If the mod is loaded in a running game it is locked; close the game first.

Game version A native mod only loads when the running stormworks64.exe matches the mapping the loader was built with (SHA-256 and byte signatures). After a game update every native mod stays out until the loader is updated. Other mods Two mods that hook the same game function both run. Two mods that change the same value fight over it, and the last writer wins. Mods that replace the same file in a mod folder conflict: the last mod folder wins, and a mod's file wins over the game's. Requirements Windows x64 CMake 3.20 or newer Visual Studio 2022 with the Desktop development with C++ workload Git Get the SDK git clone https://github.com/DeltaV-Modding/DeltaLoader cd DeltaLoader The repository contains the headers (include/sw), their sources (src), a CMakeLists.txt, the build script build_mod.ps1 and one example mod. Build the example powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build_mod.ps1 The script configures CMake for Visual Studio 2022 (x64) and builds. The DLL lands in build-mod\Release\. Parameters: -Config (default Release) and -Generator. Run it Install DeltaLauncher, put your DLL in <Stormworks>\mods\<Name>\ and switch it on. Use single-player and back up your save. See [Logging and debugging](/developer/debugging/). Game version Your mod only starts when the game matches the mapping in the SDK you built against. Update the SDK when the game updates.

1. Write the source Create src/my_mod.cpp: #include "sw/mod.hpp" SW_MOD("my_mod") // the name used in the log and the mod menu void sw_mod_start() { // runs on its own thread sw::mod::log("Hello from inside the game!"); while (sw::mod::sleep(1000)) { // false as soon as the mod is being unloaded // work once a second } } void sw_mod_stop() {} // just before unloading 2. Register it In CMakeLists.txt: sw_add_mod(my_mod src/my_mod.cpp) sw_add_mod links the mod framework, uses the static runtime and sets /W4 /permissive- /utf-8 for you. 3. Build powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build_mod.ps1 4. Load it Copy build-mod\Release\my_mod.dll to <Stormworks>\mods\my_mod\ and switch it on in the launcher. The log line Hello from inside the game! appears in the console and in %TEMP%\stormworks_mods.log. Loops must check sleep() A loop that never checks sw::mod::sleep() or sw::mod::running() blocks unloading. After 5 seconds the DLL is left loaded on purpose. Next steps [Project structure](/developer/project-structure/) [Events and hooks](/developer/hooks/) The SDK example mod places a custom island and a start card (src/example_mod.cpp).

DeltaLoader/ include/sw/ headers you include (mod.hpp is the entry point) src/ implementation of the SDK and example_mod.cpp CMakeLists.txt builds swbridge, swmodkit and defines sw_add_mod() build_mod.ps1 configure + build with Visual Studio 2022 (x64) build-mod/ build output (created by the script) Target Purpose swbridge Static library: the bridge to the game (runtime, hooks, game access). swmodkit Static library: the mod framework (SW_MOD, thread, unload). Links swbridge. your mod A DLL created by sw_add_mod(). include/sw/generated_.hpp are tables made from the mapping. They are replaced with every game update; never edit them. Tip sw/api.hpp includes the friendly headers. Include only what you need; each header is self-contained.

In the DLL SW_MOD("name") exports two functions the loader uses: swmod_name() (the name shown in the log and the in-game menu) and swmod_shutdown() (used for unloading). The macro also defines the DLL entry point. On the mods site Name, description, icon, category, version and the download file are entered on the mods site when you create a project and upload a version. See [Packaging and publishing mods](/developer/publishing/). To be documented [TODO: Confirm whether the loader reads any manifest file from a mod folder (for example for dependencies or minimum game version). The public SDK defines none.]

Load The injector checks the target: 64-bit, the right process name, no anti-cheat module, and the SHA-256 of the game executable. The DLL is loaded with LoadLibraryW. The game executable is not patched. The DllMain part of the framework starts your thread and checks the SHA-256 and all byte signatures in memory. If anything is off, sw_mod_start() is not called and the console says why. sw_mod_start() runs on its own thread. Until you set hooks, your code has no effect on game threads. Unload The loader (or the in-game mod menu) calls the export swmod_shutdown(). The framework sets sw::mod::running() to false, waits for your sw_mod_start() thread to end, calls sw_mod_stop() and removes all hooks of the mod. It waits until no game thread is still inside a callback of the DLL (sw::Hook::idle()). Only then is the DLL freed. If a callback is still busy after up to 5 seconds, the DLL is left loaded: a small leak beats a crash. Rules Loops check sw::mod::sleep(ms) or sw::mod::running(). Callbacks are short; slow work goes to the mod thread. Do not keep pointers into the DLL after sw_mod_stop().

A hook runs your callback when the game enters a function. The callback runs before the original code continues: void cb(void self, void user); // self = first argument (for a method: this) Ways to install a hook Call Hooks rt.hook_api("server.getTime", cb, user, err) A Lua API handler by name from the mapping rt.hook_ctor("c_scene_ropes", cb, user, err) The constructors of a class rt.hook_method("class", slot, cb, user, err) A virtual method by vtable slot rt.hook_rva(rva, cb, user, err) A known address (relative to the image base) rt is sw::mod::rt(). Each call returns a sw::HookStatus. Example #include "sw/mod.hpp" #include <atomic> SW_MOD("counter") static std::atomic<int> g_calls{0}; static void on_call(void, void) { ++g_calls; } void sw_mod_start() { std::string err; auto status = sw::mod::rt().hook_api("server.getTime", on_call, nullptr, err); if (status != sw::HookStatus::ok) { sw::mod::log("hook failed: %s (%s)", sw::to_string(status), err.c_str()); return; } while (sw::mod::sleep(5000)) sw::mod::log("calls: %d", g_calls.load()); } void sw_mod_stop() {} Status values Status Meaning ok The hook is installed. unsupported_arch Not x64. target_invalid The target is not inside the main module. already_hooked A hook is already at this place. decode_failed The first instructions cannot be decoded safely. relocation_failed A short jump or no memory in reach. alloc_failed, write_failed Memory could not be allocated or written. Limits Warning A callback reads integer arguments with sw::Hook::arg(n) but cannot change them. To change a value, find the caller and patch the constant it passes. Float arguments live in xmm registers and are not readable by arg. sw::Hook::install_replace can skip the original function. Hooks are removed automatically when your mod unloads; remove one early with unhook. Game events by name (for example the tile events) are in sw/events.hpp and sw/tiles.hpp.

All headers are in include/sw/ of the [public repository](https://github.com/DeltaV-Modding/DeltaLoader/tree/main/include/sw). The comments in a header say what is proven and what is not. Every call that talks to the game fails closed: it returns false or nullptr when the game does not match. The complete header reference (every header with its comments, recipes, generated tables) is the [header reference](/reference/). Mod framework sw::mod (sw/mod.hpp) Call Purpose SW_MOD("name") Declares the mod (export of name, shutdown and the DLL entry point). void sw_mod_start() / void sw_mod_stop() You write these. Start runs on its own thread. bool sw::mod::running() False as soon as the mod should unload. bool sw::mod::sleep(unsigned ms) Waits; returns false if unloading begins. Runtime& sw::mod::rt() The runtime of the game (already connected and checked). void sw::mod::log(fmt, ...) Console window and log file. Runtime sw::Runtime (sw/runtime.hpp) Call Purpose hook_api / hook_ctor / hook_method / hook_rva Install hooks (see [Events and hooks](/developer/hooks/)). resolve(api) The address of a mapped Lua handler. readable(ptr, size) Is this memory readable? read_rva<T> / write_rva<T> / write_bytes Read or write game memory. Writing changes the game. class_of(obj) / is_instance_of(obj, cls) / class_vtable(cls) Identify objects by their vtable. is_function_start(addr) Is this the start of a function in the main module? Objects sw::Instances (sw/instances.hpp) Call Purpose track(cls, err) Start watching the constructors of a class. list(cls) Addresses of the live objects. untrack(cls) / tracked() Stop watching / what is watched. Friendly headers Header Gives tiles.hpp, start_tiles.hpp, world.hpp Tile system, your own start card, islands weather.hpp Weather, wind, time of day render.hpp Frame end, OpenGL, shaders, uniforms, render targets audio.hpp, input.hpp, camera.hpp, physics.hpp Audio engine, input callbacks, cameras, the physics world vehicle.hpp Spawned vehicles and components (read only) vfs.hpp, overlay.hpp Mod folders in the game without writing network.hpp, game_state.hpp Message ids and application states flags.hpp, mapicons.hpp, textures.hpp, mesh.hpp, trees.hpp Flags, map icons, textures, meshes, trees discord.hpp Discord Rich Presence Tip The complete working example is src/example_mod.cpp in the repository.

Logging sw::mod::log("x = %d", x); // console window and %TEMP%\stormworks_mods.log, with a line end sw/console.hpp gives direct access: opening the window, writing, drawing and sw::console::log_path(). Console window The launcher's Log page shows the log; Show console brings the console to the front while the game runs. Graphics debuggers (RenderDoc, PIX) These tools must start the game themselves, which would bypass the loader. Hook failures name a HookStatus; see [Events and hooks](/developer/hooks/). A crash inside a callback usually means: callback too long, an exception, or an object used before is_instance_of.

Package A mod is the DLL, plus optional folders next to it: Data, Meshes, Graphics (any top-level folder of the game's rom). Shader-only mods need no DLL. Publish Create an account on the [mods site](https://stormworks-tools.com/). Create a project: name, description, icon, category. Upload a version (the DLL or a package). Choose Submit for review. A moderator approves it or rejects it with a reason. Nobody publishes their own project directly. The launcher reads the catalog from the public API and verifies the SHA-256 of every download. Note Mod icons with a transparent background are shown on a transparent background.

DeltaLauncher Installs, verifies, switches mods, starts the game, lays out overlays. Injector Checks the target and loads DLLs into the running game. Version patch Built into the launcher; shows the DeltaLoader label and is loaded into the game before the mods. Bridge (SDK) In every mod DLL: connects to the game, checks it, installs hooks. Mapping Names, addresses, signatures and layouts. The source of everything the bridge knows. Principles Fail closed. SHA-256 of the executable and all byte signatures must match, or nothing is delivered. No permanent changes. The game's files are not modified. Overlays are journalled and restored. No anti-cheat. The loader refuses to attach when an anti-cheat module is present. To be documented [TODO: Add a diagram of the data flow once the final design of the version patch is documented.]

In the launcher Installed mods are listed in %APPDATA%\DeltaVModdingLauncher\installed.json. The launcher detects mods by their DLLs in the game's mods folder. In the game Switches are stored in <game folder>\mods\activemods.ini as name=1. This is the file the in-game mod menu reads as well, so the launcher and the game always agree. (modmenue.ini is read as a legacy file name.) Asset folders belong to a mod by name: example.dll uses the folder <game>\mods\example. Only folders whose name matches a switched-on DLL are overlaid. Special case: the mod menu When the mod main_menu is switched on, only it is loaded. It reads activemods.ini itself and starts the other switched-on mods.

Game not running Overlays of switched-on mods are laid over rom (only folders whose name matches a switched-on DLL). Steam is asked to start stormworks64.exe (the steam:// link). If that link is not registered, the executable in the configured game folder is started directly. Once the process exists, the launcher waits for the load delay (default 5 s). The version patch is loaded, then every switched-on DLL, through the injector. When the game ends, overlays are restored. Game already running Switches are applied in place: mods the launcher loaded earlier and that are now off are unloaded (swinject unload --mod), switched-on mods are loaded, and mods already in the game are skipped. Inside a mod DLL See [Mod lifecycle](/developer/lifecycle/): target check, LoadLibraryW, in-process check of SHA-256 and signatures, then sw_mod_start().

To be documented [TODO: Document dependency resolution. No dependency system is part of the launcher or SDK as far as the public sources show.] Load order today follows the order of the switched-on mods; the launcher loads the version patch first, then the DLLs.

Stormworks is a native program, and mods are native DLLs, not .NET assemblies. Loading is done with the Windows LoadLibraryW function by the injector. The DLL's entry point (DllMain, defined by SW_MOD) starts the mod thread and runs the checks. Unloading calls the export swmod_shutdown() and then frees the DLL, after all hooks are removed and no game thread is inside a callback. The launcher copies the DLL into the game's mods folder. A copy loaded by the injector is tracked (swinject mods lists the copies it loaded).

The runtime (sw::Runtime) is a singleton inside each mod DLL. It attaches to the main module of the game, checks it and offers: Address resolution from the mapping: Lua handlers by name, class vtables and constructors, RVAs. Hooks on function entries: the first instructions are decoded and relocated to a detour; the target must lie in the main module. Hook::plan runs the same decoding on arbitrary bytes without writing. Memory access with a readability check; writing is explicit. Object identification from the vtable pointer. Hook memory is allocated near the image so rip-relative displacements still fit. Callbacks run on the game thread that called the function. What is not done Arguments of a hooked function are read-only integer registers. Float arguments are not exposed.

Two independent checks run before any mod code starts: The injector compares the SHA-256 of the game executable on disk with the mapping. The mod's bridge compares the SHA-256 again inside the process and checks every byte signature of the mapping against the running code. If either check fails, sw_mod_start() is not called and the console names the reason. This is intentional: a wrong address would corrupt the game, while a refused start only costs you a wait. A patch that changes game code (for example the version label) checks the bytes at the patch site first and refuses on a mismatch.

Thing Versioned by Game The Steam build; the mapping is tied to the SHA-256 of one executable. Launcher Semantic version, published on the mods site. It updates itself. Injector Its own version, embedded in the launcher; older installed copies are replaced. Mods Versions uploaded to the mods site; the launcher compares and offers updates. After a game update, the mapping is moved to the new build by fingerprinting the machine code (addresses masked), then verified against the bytes. Anything that cannot be proven stays unresolved.

Not stable These interfaces are internal. They may change without notice. Mods API (launcher ↔ site) A Modrinth-shaped API: /v2/search, /v2/project/{id}, /v2/project/{id}/version, /v2/version/{id}, /v2/tag/category. The injector is a project of type tool with the slug swinject. Launcher ↔ injector The launcher calls the injector as a command line tool and parses its output: loading a DLL, unload --mod, mods, console show|hide|toggle|status, gamepath. deltav://install deltav://install?slug=<slug> asks the launcher to install the latest version of a project. A running launcher receives it over a loopback socket; a stopped one starts with the URL as its argument.
